name: Sylvan-Rift
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in an orbital debris ring. Travelers navigate by tectonic rift valleys and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Relatives of the lost still charter quiet ships to fly the debris fan. Sometimes they hire escorts. Sometimes they need them.
